description: On the narrowest phone (320px) the home match cards still fit, with the longest labels (Spanish, Portuguese) and Japanese

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#match-list .match'); i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); return document.querySelectorAll('#match-list .match').length > 0; })()

(() => { const W = document.documentElement.clientWidth; if (document.documentElement.scrollWidth > W || document.body.scrollWidth > W) return false; return ![...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].some((e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width && r.right > W + 1 && !e.closest('.table-wrap'); }); })()
